bindings.why: The same complete receipt's selected real settlement already has its committed fact. Reversal and re-recording on the invoker's Sql are invisible to another connection and both disappear on caller rollback; a committed replay is inert. Original payment and GL are not changed.

The real selected settlement's reversal and next generation use the same caller transaction, remain invisible before commit and disappear with rollback along with their reserved feed numbers; independent persisted snapshots match.
PostgreSQL introspection on the live selected world equals independently declared exact fields, nullability, keys, indexes, checks and forced row policy.
The actual world migration has exactly the blueprint money-evidence columns and indexes; no accounting or chart columns are admitted.
The actual feed schema has only its organization, counter and timestamps with the declared key and constraints.
A second real company's restricted connection cannot read, update or insert the first's persisted annotation; the original row is unchanged.
A second real tenant cannot read or insert the first's actual fact. Its append-only permissions independently prohibit updates and deletes.
A second real tenant reads none of the first's existing counter, updates zero rows and cannot insert into its scope; before and after match.
Runtime SQL writes stay inside the owning concept and actual public authorized saves produce the persisted replacement rows and exact source events.
Only concept-owned runtime SQL appends facts through the declared same-Sql procedures/save; actual restricted PostgreSQL denies updates and deletes, and both procedures roll back atomically.
Feed writes remain concept-owned and its counter's before/after snapshots roll back with the declared fact writers on real selected money.

A real public personal save first decides its own row; independent PostgreSQL reads verify state, editor and exactly one common-outbox assign event with exact blueprint props, world time and correlated trace.
A first public memo save persists waiting and exactly one queue source event; it creates no organization fact or copied site data.
A later real public account replacement persists decided and emits one exact recategorize transition from the prior committed state.
A public replacement into the fixed undecided personal code persists waiting and one exact requeue event; suggestion/memo are absent from event props.

Twenty warmed actual public saves on separate chain-proven organization money call the real person's native Account resolver. Observed round-trip p95, a conservative bound on server time, is at most the declared 4000ms vendor budget.

Authoritative shared PostgreSQL span reads for each actual native public call retain the RPC span and real parented provider child, under this exact receipt/world/trace; missing sink or substituted records cannot score.
